description.workers.farmer: Plants crops using seeds from nearby storage and harvests fields when they are ready. Automatically works on farmland within range and keeps crops growing efficiently.
description.workers.miner: Mines a defined area and Places torches while working. Provides safety by filling holes with cobblestone and can optionally cover the ground to prevent dangerous falls.
description.workers.lumberjack: Cuts down trees inside a lumber area and can strip logs or replant saplings when instructed. Keeps forests managed and renewable.
description.workers.builder: Builds saved structures block by block and requires all needed materials. Collects resources from the nearest depot before starting construction.
description.workers.merchant: Trades with other players on your behalf using predefined trade offers. Can take required items from a dedicated depot if permitted.
description.workers.fisherman: Uses a fishing rod to fish in a defined fishing area and casts lines along a set route. Collects nearby fish and items, stores them in a nearby depot, and handles the rod carefully to extend its durability.
description.workers.animalFarmer: Takes care of animals in defined pens. Breeds the animals faster and efficient than a player could .
description.workers.courier: Transports items along a defined route. Picks up goods from a source location and delivers them to a target location, keeping your supply chains running smoothly.
description.workers.cook: Runs a Kitchen work area. Collects raw ingredients from chests, cooks them in furnaces. If required, serves food to nearby villagers to boost breeding. Needs at least one furnace and one chest. Fuel must be supplied by the player or a Courier.

description.workers.craftsman: Runs a Workshop work area. Crafts and smelts the orders set up in the workshop with the items from its chests and puts the results back. Needs at least one crafting table, one furnace and four chests.

gui.workers.workshop.tooltip.mode: Keep in stock: the craftsman keeps this many in the workshop chests and refills them when items are taken. Make once: this many are made one time, then the order is done.
gui.workers.workshop.tooltip.autoFuel: Fuel is taken automatically: coal or charcoal first, then planks, then logs.
gui.workers.checkbox.tooltip.allowVarian: If enabled, every variant the recipe accepts may be used (e.g. any planks), otherwise only the exact items of the grid.

gui.workers.checkbox.tooltip.useStorage: The craftsman fetches missing items from a nearby storage and brings finished products there. Storages need the "Craftsmen" checkbox. Without a storage everything stays in the workshop.
gui.workers.checkbox.tooltip.useStorageK: The cook fetches raw food and coal from a nearby storage when the kitchen runs out. If feeding villagers is off, he brings cooked food to the storage. Storages need the "Cooks" checkbox.
gui.workers.checkbox.tooltip.useStorageM: The merchant refills trade goods from a nearby storage and brings items he bought from villagers there. Storages need the "Merchants" checkbox. Villager trades always use it, player trades have their own checkbox. Emeralds and currency always stay in the market.
gui.workers.tooltip.villagerTradeMode: Sell: the merchant sells the item to villagers for emeralds. Buy: he buys the item from villagers with emeralds from the market. Both only at the normal price, never when villagers raise it because of demand.
